name: Jerusha
title: Mother of King Jotham of Judah
summary: Jerusha (also spelled Jerusha) was the daughter of Zadok and wife of King Uzziah (Azariah) of Judah. She was the mother of King Jotham, who succeeded his father as king over Judah. She is known primarily through brief references in the Books of Kings and Chronicles.

keyEvents.title: Mentioned as Jotham's mother
keyEvents.description: Jerusha is mentioned as the daughter of Zadok and mother of King Jotham in connection with Jotham's reign over Judah.

keyEvents.title: Mentioned in Chronicles
keyEvents.description: In 2 Chronicles it is confirmed that Jerusha was the daughter of Zadok and mother of Jotham, who reigned as king in Jerusalem.

keyEvents.title: Wife of King Uzziah
keyEvents.description: Jerusha was married to King Uzziah (Azariah), who reigned for 52 years over Judah, but who was struck with leprosy after acting wrongly in the temple.

keyEvents.title: Jotham takes over as regent
keyEvents.description: When her husband Uzziah became leprous, his son Jotham took charge of the king's house and judged the people in the land. The son of Jerusha proved to be a capable ruler.

keyEvents.title: Jotham becomes king after Uzziah's death
keyEvents.description: After Uzziah's death, Jotham son of Jerusha was formally installed as king over Judah. He reigned for 16 years and did what was right in the Lord's eyes.
